title: SLA-gated enrichment workflow for hosted chat + tool requests
creator: Priya Singh
description:
Goal: Design and implement an SLA-aware intake and enrichment workflow for Hosted API feature requests that involve chat, streaming, tool/function calling, or structured outputs. The workflow should automatically gate, score, and enrich incoming enterprise requests so PM+Solutions can prioritize rollout-ready items that require dedicated capacity, enhanced SLOs, or custom security controls. Scope includes intake schema updates, enrichment steps (usage telemetry, tenant SLO, compliance flags), scoring rules, and a handoff path to engineering and design queues.

Acceptance criteria:
- New intake form fields captured for streaming, toolchains, structured outputs, and requested SLOs (p50/p95 latency, throughput, retention).
- Automated enrichment pulls tenant usage signals (daily RPS, feature flags) and recent incident history from observability dashboards.
- Scoring engine produces a numeric priority score and a short rationale string for each submission.
- SLA gate: submissions requesting enterprise SLAs or dedicated capacity are flagged and routed to 'Enterprise Review' queue with SLA rationale.
- Handoff artifacts generated automatically: PRD stub, suggested rollout strategy (canary/capacity), initial engineering estimate range, and security checklist if KMS/HSM or VPC is requested.
- Console: a new 'Intake' view that surface enriched fields and allows PM to accept/defer/escalate.

Design decisions to finalize:
- Minimal required fields vs optional enrichment to maximize conversion for self-serve customers.
- Scoring weight tradeoffs: customer revenue, expected token volume, SLA requested, regulatory constraints.
- Whether canary policies should be suggested or auto-attached for high-risk changes.

Non-goals:
- Building full automation for rollout (this ticket stops at generating handoff artifacts).
- Implementing dedicated capacity provisioning flows (depends on ENG-43210).

Artifacts and links:
- Draft PRD: https://docs.internal.redwood/prd/pm-31542-sla-gated-intake (draft)
- Intake UI mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/mockups/pm-31542 (work in progress)
- Observability query examples: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/intake-enrichment-queries

Stakeholders:
- PM: Priya Singh (owner)
- Eng leads: Diego Morales (assignee), Mei Chen (runtime), Carlos Rivera (console)
- Design: Ava Patel
- Solutions/SE: Leah Thompson
- Compliance/Security: Jordan Lee

Metrics of success (first 90 days):
- % of enterprise intake items with complete enrichment >= 90%
- Median time from submission to engineering-ready artifact <= 3 business days
- Reduction in ad-hoc enterprise triage meetings by 40%

Rollout plan (high-level):
1) Week 1-2: finalize intake schema + quick mocks with Design.
2) Week 3-4: build enrichment jobs (telemetry pulls, incident history).
3) Week 5: implement scoring rules and SLA gating logic.
4) Week 6: lightweight console view + handoff templates.
5) Week 7: small pilot with 3 enterprise customers; collect feedback and iterate.

Next steps (owner):
- Kick-off sync with engineering and design (scheduled 2026-03-08).
- Create ENG tickets for enrichment jobs and console view (blocked by dependency ENG-43210).
